plank.setup: Forearms or hands down, body in one straight line, core braced.
steps: Set the elbows under the shoulders and the body in a straight line.
Brace the core and squeeze the glutes so the hips stay level.
Hold — breathing steadily — without letting the hips sag or rise.
Target: hold 3 × 20s with clean form.
plank.cue: Pull the belly in and tuck the ribs. Flat back from heels to head.
plank.mistake: Hips sagging toward the floor or piking up into a tent.

tuck-sit.setup: Support on straight arms, shoulders pressed down away from the ears.
steps: Press down hard to lift the hips clear of the floor.
Raise straight legs to horizontal, toes pointed.
Hold the L — shoulders depressed, thighs squeezed, no leaning back.
Target: hold 3 × 20s with clean form.
tuck-sit.cue: Push the ground down and lift the legs by the hip flexors, arms locked.
tuck-sit.mistake: Shrugging the shoulders or bending the knees to hold the height.

dragon-flag.setup: Lie back holding a support behind the head, shoulders pinned down.
steps: Drive the whole body up until only the shoulders rest on the surface.
Lower in one rigid line — no bend at the hips — as slowly as you can.
Stop just short of the floor and drive back up.
Target: 3 sets of 12 controlled reps. Requires: Plank.
dragon-flag.cue: The body is one plank pivoting at the shoulders. Keep it dead straight.
dragon-flag.mistake: Piking at the hips so the legs drop first.

wall-hs.setup: Hands shoulder-width, fingers spread, arms locked overhead.
steps: Stack the hips over the shoulders and the shoulders over the hands.
Push the floor away hard, ribs tucked and glutes tight in one straight line.
Balance with small pressure changes through the fingertips, not the whole hand.
Target: hold 3 × 20s with clean form.
wall-hs.cue: Push tall through the shoulders and grip the floor with the fingertips.
wall-hs.mistake: Banana back — ribs flared and hips arched behind the hands.

hamstring-bridge.setup: Kneel with the ankles anchored, body upright, hips extended.
steps: Keep a straight line from knees to head and lower forward slowly.
Resist with the hamstrings the whole way down — fight the fall.
Pull yourself back up, or push off lightly and repeat.
Target: 3 sets of 12 controlled reps.
hamstring-bridge.cue: Hips stay open — do not bend at the waist to make it easier.
hamstring-bridge.mistake: Breaking at the hips instead of holding the knee-to-head line.

nordic-hamstring-curl.setup: Kneel with the ankles anchored, body upright, hips extended.
steps: Keep a straight line from knees to head and lower forward slowly.
Resist with the hamstrings the whole way down — fight the fall.
Pull yourself back up, or push off lightly and repeat.
Target: 3 sets of 12 controlled reps. Requires: Hamstring Bridge.
nordic-hamstring-curl.cue: Hips stay open — do not bend at the waist to make it easier.
nordic-hamstring-curl.mistake: Breaking at the hips instead of holding the knee-to-head line.

squat.setup: Stand tall, feet about shoulder-width, chest up and core braced.
steps: Sit the hips back and down, knees tracking over the toes.
Descend to at least parallel while keeping the heels planted and chest tall.
Drive through the whole foot to stand back up.
Target: 3 sets of 12 controlled reps.
squat.cue: Knees follow the toes, weight through the heels and mid-foot.
squat.mistake: Knees caving in or the heels lifting off the floor.

pull-up.setup: Dead hang from the bar, shoulders active, core braced, legs still.
steps: Pull the elbows down and back, driving the chest toward the bar.
Bring the chin over the bar without kipping or swinging.
Lower all the way to a full dead hang and repeat.
Target: 3 sets of 12 controlled reps.
pull-up.cue: Start by pulling the shoulder blades down before the arms bend.
pull-up.mistake: Kicking the legs to kip, or stopping short of a full hang.

push-up.setup: Hands under the shoulders, body in one straight line from heels to head, core and glutes tight.
steps: Lower under control until the chest is a fist off the floor, elbows tracking back at roughly 45°.
Keep the line from heels to head rigid — the hips do not sag or pike.
Press back to full lockout and repeat.
Target: 3 sets of 12 controlled reps.
push-up.cue: Elbows back, not flared. Squeeze the glutes so the hips never lead.
push-up.mistake: Sagging hips or elbows flaring straight out to the sides.

dip.setup: Supported on straight arms, shoulders down, slight forward lean of the torso.
steps: Lower until the shoulders drop just below the elbows, elbows tracking back.
Keep the torso leaned slightly forward and the shoulders away from the ears.
Press back to a strong lockout at the top.
Target: 3 sets of 12 controlled reps. Requires: Push-Up.
dip.cue: Shoulders down and back — never shrug up toward the ears.
dip.mistake: Shrugging at the bottom or flaring the elbows wide.

ring-turn-out.setup: Support on top of the rings, arms straight, rings turned slightly out.
steps: Press down and turn the rings out to about 45°.
Hold the arms locked and the shoulders down, body tight and tall.
Keep the rings from drifting — steady them with active straight arms.
Target: 3 sets of 12 controlled reps.
ring-turn-out.cue: Turn the rings out and lock the elbows. Fight the wobble with the whole arm.
ring-turn-out.mistake: Bent arms or letting the rings turn back in and the shoulders shrug.

ring-push-up.setup: Support on the rings, arms straight, rings turned out, body tight.
steps: Lower under control, keeping the rings close to the body.
Descend until the shoulders drop below the elbows without losing tension.
Press back up and turn the rings out at the top.
Target: 3 sets of 12 controlled reps. Requires: Ring Turn Out.
ring-push-up.cue: Keep the rings pulled in tight to the ribs the whole descent.
ring-push-up.mistake: Letting the rings drift wide, which throws the shoulders forward.

pseudo-push-up.setup: Hands at hip level, fingers turned out, shoulders leaning forward past the wrists.

Lower a few inches while holding that forward lean, then press the floor away.
The further forward the lean, the closer this gets to a planche.

bulgarian-dip.mistake: Letting the rings drift wide, which throws the shoulders forward.

Target: hold 3 × 10s with clean form. Requires: Morozov.
ring-planche.cue: Straight arms driven down and in. Everything is locked and pulling toward the midline.
ring-planche.mistake: Bending the arms or dropping the chest to shorten the lever.
